agreement.note: All 60 deterministic headline numbers agree exactly at the stated rounding. The 10 Monte Carlo rates (mc_*) use different RNGs (numpy PCG64 vs R Mersenne-Twister, same seed 20261272); largest Python-R difference 0.011. Exact false-alarm rates (exact_*) are computed by enumeration and agree exactly.
